rationale: Third-party bodily injury (child's broken wrist) arising from a hazardous condition on the policyholder's premises (icy walkway), which is a classic liability scenario covered by homeowners policy.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping on an icy walkway at the front of the policyholder's house during last week's ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical bills. Pediatric injury with high severity; liability coverage applies under POL-1002 ($500k limit).

case_facts.incident_type: slip and fall on icy walkway
case_facts.damage_description: medical bills for broken wrist treatment
case_facts.premises_condition: icy walkway on policyholder property; visitor approached door
